labels.usesA: A distinctive observed purpose or operation from donor A has a necessary role, not merely its name or language.
labels.usesB: A distinctive observed purpose or operation from donor B has a necessary role.
labels.concreteMechanism: There is a specific input, mapping/operation connecting both donors, and visible output. Two independent outputs do not suffice.
labels.unsupportedClaim: The text asserts an unobserved existing real capability or guarantee. Clearly fictional scenes and explicitly proposed prototypes alone are not unsupported claims.
